title: Quality of Life and Function of Patients With Pelvic Tumors After Undergoing Hemipelvectomy
official: Quality of Life and Function of Patients After Hemipelvectomy
summary: This study aims to determine the functional outcomes of patients who underwent internal hemipelvectomy with or without reconstruction or external hemipelvectomy for pelvic tumors. Learning about the outcomes of these patients may help researchers determine the long-term effects of different types of hemipelvectomy procedures and may help improve quality of life.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients within the institution who have undergone or will undergo a hemipelvectomy

Exclusion Criteria:

\- None
